architecture.mechanism: ALD deposition of tantalum-based composite films creates a dense, continuous, and smooth surface layer that significantly improves corrosion resistance in chloride environments.
architecture.intervention: Apply ALD-deposited TaOxNy or TaN/TaOx multilayer coatings to the interior surfaces of the 90/10 copper-nickel condenser tubes.
architecture.expected_effect: Extended service life of condenser tubes beyond 18 months, reduced pitting corrosion, and minimized thermal resistance increase from biofilm formation.
architecture.falsification_test: Salt spray testing and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy on coated vs. uncoated copper-nickel samples in simulated polluted estuary water.
